roic.description: Exceptional capital efficiency. Apple generates 56% return on every dollar invested.

fcf.description: Massive free cash flow generation of ~$100B annually.

fcf_margin.description: 26% of revenue converts to free cash flow. Excellent capital-light model.

revenue_cagr.description: Steady 9% annual revenue growth over the past 5 years.

net_income_cagr.description: 12% profit growth outpacing revenue - margin expansion at work.

operating_margin_stability.description: Operating margins consistently above 28%, showing pricing power.

net_margin_stability.description: Net margins stable around 25%. Best-in-class profitability.

reinvestment_rate.description: Low reinvestment needs (15%) due to capital-light services model.

dividend_cagr.description: Dividends growing at 7% annually, though Apple prefers buybacks.

net_debt_ebitda.description: Minimal net debt relative to earnings. Strong balance sheet.

recession_performance.description: Maintained growth through 2020 pandemic. Strong ecosystem lock-in.
